roles/container.admin.title: Kubernetes Engine Admin
roles/container.admin.desc: Provides access to full management of clusters and their Kubernetes API objects. To set a service account on nodes, you must also have the Service Account User role (roles/iam.serviceAccountUser) on the user-managed service account that your nodes will use.

roles/container.cloudKmsKeyUser.title: Kubernetes Engine KMS Crypto Key User
roles/container.cloudKmsKeyUser.desc: Allow the Kubernetes Engine service agent in the cluster project to call KMS with user provided crypto keys to sign payloads.

roles/container.clusterAdmin.title: Kubernetes Engine Cluster Admin
roles/container.clusterAdmin.desc: Provides access to management of clusters. To set a service account on nodes, you must also have the Service Account User role (roles/iam.serviceAccountUser) on the user-managed service account that your nodes will use.

roles/container.clusterViewer.title: Kubernetes Engine Cluster Viewer
roles/container.clusterViewer.desc: Provides access to get and list GKE clusters.

roles/container.defaultNodeServiceAccoun.title: Kubernetes Engine Default Node Service Account
roles/container.defaultNodeServiceAccoun.desc: Least privilege role to use as the default service account for GKE Nodes.

roles/container.defaultNodeServiceAgent.title: Kubernetes Engine Default Node Service Agent
roles/container.defaultNodeServiceAgent.desc: Minimal set of permissions required by a GKE node to support standard capabilities such as logging and monitoring. Replaces the container.nodeServiceAgent role with a reduced permission set.

roles/container.developer.title: Kubernetes Engine Developer
roles/container.developer.desc: Provides access to Kubernetes API objects inside clusters.

roles/container.hostServiceAgentUser.title: Kubernetes Engine Host Service Agent User
roles/container.hostServiceAgentUser.desc: Allows the Kubernetes Engine service account in the host project to configure shared network resources for cluster management. Also gives access to inspect the firewall rules in the host project.

roles/container.nodeServiceAgent.title: [Deprecated] Kubernetes Engine Node Service Agent
roles/container.nodeServiceAgent.desc: Minimal set of permission required by a GKE node to support standard capabilities such as logging and monitoring export, and image pulls.

roles/container.serviceAgent.title: Kubernetes Engine Service Agent
roles/container.serviceAgent.desc: Gives Kubernetes Engine account access to manage cluster resources. Includes access to service accounts.

roles/container.viewer.title: Kubernetes Engine Viewer
roles/container.viewer.desc: Provides read-only access to resources within GKE clusters, such as nodes, pods, and GKE API objects.
